Hide the VIP card on the Mine page
Hides only the VIP card and removes its space; other Mine-page entries remain unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Makes the official updater treat checks as already up to date; it does not affect this module\'s update checks. Restart Bilibili to apply.

Selects Video when the Dynamic page builds its tabs, without scanning or simulating UI clicks. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Displays non-negative integer counts without ten-thousand or hundred-million abbreviations. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Closes only Bilibili’s dedicated teen-mode prompt Activity after it is created. Teen-mode state and settings remain unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Hides the Gemini player’s “Full Story” portrait-feed switch while preserving fullscreen controls. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Changes only the player’s initial quality request and does not unlock paid tiers. Bilibili may still downgrade it for the video, account, or network. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Preserves Bilibili’s automatic quality, account, and restricted-mode decisions.
Uses this tier for the initial request; the host or server may still downgrade it.
Keeps comment text and emoji intact while disabling only keyword links that open Bilibili search. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Removes only the one-tap posting guide shown when a comment section is empty; the comment tab remains available. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Hides poll and side-picking widgets in comments without changing normal likes, replies, or comment text. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Hides follow buttons beside comments and in header decorations while keeping other badges, text, and interactions. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Suppresses comment-experience surveys by replacing only the top-level QOE payload at its public read boundary. Comment content and interactions remain unchanged. Restart Bilibili to apply.
Suppresses top-level Operation and OperationV2 promotional payloads through their public read boundaries without modifying comments or reply data. Restart Bilibili to apply.
